svg.text: HOW TO MAKE IT AND HOW IT FITS

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Cut the sheet to 900 x 345 mm; keep the film on while working.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Duct hole 106 mm diameter, centre on the middle line, 240 mm

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: back from the front edge. Cut with a hole saw at low speed.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Screw holes 6 mm (oversize for heat movement), 10 mm in from the

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: edges: front and back at 110 and 330 mm each side of the middle;

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: each side 120 and 220 mm back from the front edge.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Hanger holes: two 4.5 mm, 93 mm back from the front edge,

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: 150 and 200 mm right of the middle.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Fit: lies on the top frame; M5 screws with large washers.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Duct collar: bought 100 mm flanged spigot through the hole,

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: flange on top, four M4 screws and a silicone bead.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Check: no cracks from any hole; the sheet lies flat.
